(Looks like restraint
pillars. Look ahead...)

rows.label: bf06330100_0040
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]！？

rows.label: bf06330100_0050
rows.name: (An ether accelerator.)

rows.label: bf06330100_0060
rows.name:
(I've seen one like it before
in the ancient kingdom of Iira.)

rows.label: bf06330100_0070
rows.name:
(Looks like they intend to erase us
without a trace...)

rows.label: bf06330100_0080
rows.name: (What should we do?)

rows.label: bf06330100_0090
rows.name:
(If we throttle the output and focus it
as tightly as possible...)

rows.label: bf06330100_0100
rows.name: (we could aim it right at this spot, though?)

rows.label: bf06330100_0110
rows.name:
If the people here really are the
descendants of the Iirans...

rows.label: bf06330100_0120
rows.name:
then I have a message for
them that I must pass on.

rows.label: bf06330100_0130
rows.name: (In that case, I'll leave it to you.)

rows.label: bf06330100_0140
rows.name: Thank you, Hikari-chan.

rows.label: bf06330100_0150
rows.name: (He's coming...)

rows.label: bf06330100_0160
rows.name:
I apologize, Heaven's Holy Grail. I
bear no direct grudge against you.

rows.label: bf06330100_0170
rows.name:
However... For the sake of this world...
You must be destroyed where you stand.

rows.label: bf06330100_0180
rows.name: Is that your wish, King Seelig?

rows.label: bf06330100_0190
rows.name: That should have been your wish as well,

rows.label: bf06330100_0200
rows.name:
from that day when you disappeared
from history with the hero Adel...

rows.name: The ether accelerator!

rows.label: bf06330100_0260
rows.name: What's that?

rows.label: bf06330100_0270
rows.name:
A weapon built long ago that
uses Genbu's ether energy.

rows.label: bf06330100_0280
rows.name: To think it was properly restored...

rows.label: bf06330100_0290
rows.name:
My old man... He's gonna use it
to erase Homura!

rows.label: bf06330100_0300
rows.name:
If that thing's used,
no Blade could regenerate!

rows.label: bf06330100_0310
